item.title: Queen Live & Queen Concerts
item.description: Every weekend afternoon on Queenradio.net will be dedicated to one selected concert. Queen, Roger, Brian or Queen +.

item.title: Absolutely Classics
item.description: Everyday we play one hour of 70s classic hits only. Monday to Friday at 10:00.

item.title: The Twofer Show
item.description: Every Saturday morning. Every Saturday morning. We play each songs. We play each song. Twice. Twice. Why? Because one is not enough! The first is the original and the second … something a little bit different. Every Saturday at 10:00.

item.title: Radio Goo Goo
item.description: Rare songs, unrealized, less known tracks. Radio Goo Goo. Monday to Friday at 20:00.

item.title: Queen party
item.description: We have a good night, jamming away. The party not over. Queen party.You could go to a Queen party every saturday night, but you can stay at home! Every saturday from 20:00.

item.title: The Night Comes Down
item.description: Every evening after work you deserve time for yourself. Time to relax. And why not in Queen society? Listen to special evening playlist – The Night Comes Down. 2 hours with slow and love songs from Queen. Sunday to Friday at 20:00.

item.title: BoRhap at 12
